html:
It's 3:29 in the morning in Tehran, and I am drowning my sense of self in this ambient vocal song called 'Lovers Against the Rocks' by Cremation Lily. Here's the Deutsch-to-English translation of the lyrics I found --by a generous youtube user-- it goes like this:

"You are just standing there like a child, waiting for someone to grab your hand and pull you through the faces of your memories. You are looking into the past with no thoughts and selfishly, you settle with your sight. Sex becomes plastic and useless. These things have little to no meaning as a child. As a child, alcohol tastes bad. As an adult, it tastes like nothing."
